12.t: Working with data: drugs and synapses
q: Calculate the percentage increase with drug B.
Explain how blocking receptors reduces the signal.
Neurotransmitter cannot bind to the receptors on the next neurone, so fewer impulses start in it.
Explain why drug B increases the signal.
The neurotransmitter is not removed from the gap, so it stays and keeps binding to receptors: the next neurone is stimulated for longer.
